name: claude-code-self-tools
description: Small Claude Code plugins that let a session act on itself: compact or clear its conversation, reload its plugins, reconnect an MCP server, read its context window, wake itself later, turn on Remote Control under a title, exit or restart, and switch to another conversation. Install only the ones you want.

plugins.name: self-compact
plugins.description: Compacts the conversation once the turn ends, at the break between two pieces of work, then resumes on its own.

plugins.name: self-clear
plugins.description: Clears the conversation once the turn ends, between two independent pieces of work, and starts the next piece from a handoff it writes.

plugins.name: self-reload
plugins.description: Reloads the session's plugins once the turn ends, as /reload-plugins does, then resumes on its own.

plugins.name: self-mcp
plugins.description: Reconnects an MCP server that broke (one by name, or all) once the turn ends, as /mcp reconnect does, then resumes on its own.

plugins.name: self-context
plugins.description: Reads how full the context window is, and whether auto-compact is on, to decide whether to compact at a break.

plugins.name: self-wake
plugins.description: Wakes the session some minutes after the turn ends with a note it sends itself, to check back on slow work.

plugins.name: self-remote-control
plugins.description: Reports on the session's Remote Control, connects it under a title, and renames the session. It runs /remote-control only while the session is not connected.

plugins.name: self-exit
plugins.description: Ends the session once the turn ends, as /exit does, with a stated reason recorded in its transcript for whoever resumes it.

plugins.name: self-restart
plugins.description: Restarts the session on Windows once the turn ends: a new window, or the pane's slot, resumes the same conversation once the old process has exited, then resumes work on its own.

plugins.name: self-switch
plugins.description: Switches the terminal to another conversation on Windows once the turn ends, for your own use: only when that conversation is open nowhere on this machine and nothing runs under this session; in place, in the pane's slot, or in a new window. It refuses where the coordinator runs switches.
